labels.text: How can I help you today?

S7.01.needs: a signed-in account (the greeting only shows when signed in)
S7.01.note: The greeting is hidden when signed out; the empty area is centred by CSS in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts (#sp-empty, flex centred).
steps: Open the AGI side panel with Command+Shift+K (Chrome shortcut "Open AGI side panel").
If a chat already has messages, click the "New chat" icon in the header.
Look at the empty chat: the greeting heading and the "How can I help you today?" box should sit in the middle of the open area, not at the top with an empty transcript above.
S7.01.where: Side panel > header icon "New chat" (or open the side panel with Command+Shift+K on a fresh start)

S7.02.needs: a chat with a long reply
S7.02.note: The column width is set by --sp-reading-column (768px) in apps/extension/src/side_panel.css and by #sp-messages padding in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts.
steps: Open the AGI side panel with Command+Shift+K and open a chat with a long written reply.
Widen the Chrome side panel by dragging its left edge as far as it goes.
Look at the reply text: it should stay in a column that is centred and stops at a readable width instead of stretching to the full window.
S7.02.where: Side panel > any chat that has a written reply

S7.03.needs: a file or table to view
S7.03.note: Not found. Searched apps/extension/src for full width, data analysis, spreadsheet, wide layout and fullWidth: only a CSV/XLSX export helper (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts) and unrelated matches. No full-width data layout exists in the code.

S7.06.needs: a Chrome window with a normal web page open
S7.06.note: The split is Chrome's own side panel. Clicking the toolbar icon does not open it in code (openPanelOnActionClick is false in apps/extension/src/background.ts); the in-page "Open in side panel" button also works.
steps: Open an ordinary web page (https) in a Chrome tab.
Press Command+Shift+K to open the AGI side panel.
Look at the window: the AGI side panel should sit beside the web page, with the page still visible next to the conversation.
S7.06.where: Command+Shift+K (Chrome shortcut named "Open AGI side panel"), with a normal web page open

S7.12.needs: a signed-in account to see saved chats
S7.12.note: The secondary navigation is an overlay sheet (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts, #sp-recents), not a side column; it opens and closes.
steps: Open the AGI side panel and click the clock icon in the header (title "Recent chats").
The Recent chats sheet opens over the chat. Click the X button labelled "Close recent chats".
Click the clock icon again and check that the list opens again and the chat behind it is back in view after closing.
S7.12.where: Side panel > header clock icon "Recent chats"

S7.17.needs: a chat that contains an image
S7.17.note: The viewer handles images only; the code has no video viewer. The X button has no visible text, only the label "Close".
steps: Open a chat reply that contains an image (for example one an image tool made or one you attached).
Click the image. A dark full-screen view with the picture should open.
Press Escape, click the X at the top right, or click the dark background, and check that you are back at the chat.
S7.17.where: Side panel > chat reply that shows an image > click the image

S7.18.needs: an approved website; the "Page assistant overlay" setting is on by default
S7.18.note: Expected says a small always-on-top window floats over other apps; the code draws a fixed button inside the web page (apps/extension/src/features/content/in-page-panel/launcher.ts) and hides it while the side panel is open (apps/extension/src/inPagePanel/setup.ts). The setting is "Page assistant overlay" under Extension settings > Options.
steps: Open an https web page on a site you have approved for AGI (AGI asks when needed).
Look at the bottom right of the page for the round AGI button; hover it to see "Ask AGI".
Switch to another app and check: the button only exists inside that web page and does not float over other apps as its own window.
S7.18.where: Any approved web page (https) > round AGI button at the bottom right of the page (hover tooltip "Ask AGI")

labels.text: Ask one question about this page…

S7.19.note: The panel is one prompt at a time with no saved chats, per the Settings text "One prompt and response at a time."
steps: Open an approved web page and click the round AGI button.
Look at the panel titled "AGI page assistant": it shows a single question box with "Ask one question about this page…" and an "Open in side panel" button.
Ask one question and check there is no conversation list or sidebar and that only one prompt and response show at a time.
S7.19.where: Any approved web page > click the round AGI button > "AGI page assistant" panel

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S7.20.needs: a chat with enough messages to scroll
steps: Open a chat with a long reply in the AGI side panel.
Look at the box "How can I help you today?" at the bottom of the panel.
Scroll the reply up and down and check the box stays at the bottom while only the reply moves.

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S7.21.note: The box grows by CSS (field-sizing: content, max-height 120px in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts); there is no separate larger editor in the code.
steps: Click the message box at the bottom of the side panel.
Type a long prompt, pressing Return for new lines so it goes several lines long.
Check that the box grows taller as lines are added, and that after it reaches its limit it scrolls inside instead of growing further.
S7.21.where: Side panel > click the box "How can I help you today?"

S7.22.needs: a chat long enough to scroll
steps: Open a chat long enough to scroll.
Scroll the reply area with the mouse wheel or trackpad.
Check that the header, the side panel controls and the message box do not move while the reply scrolls.

S7.23.needs: a chat reply that creates an artifact
S7.23.note: The header is a separate block above the scrolling body (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts), so it stays put by layout. The header also has an "open on web" button, which Expected does not list.
steps: Ask for something that creates an artifact (for example a short web page or code file) and wait for the artifact card.
Click "Open" on the card; the artifact panel opens above the chat with its header.
Scroll the artifact body and check that the header with "Preview", "Code" and the copy, download and close buttons stays in place.
S7.23.where: Side panel > a reply with an artifact card > "Open" on the card

S7.25.note: Not found. The only width rules are padding changes at 390px and 340px in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts. The artifact panel always stacks above the chat and Recent chats is always an overlay, so there is no side-by-side panel to stack.

S7.29.needs: a Chrome side panel you can resize
S7.29.note: Not found. Searched apps/extension/src for min-width, max-width and resize handles: no minimum or maximum width for the panel. The side panel width is set by Chrome, and manifest.json sets none.
